question: Would the desk's own entry (the empty-square arm on the dual %R lines) taken PREMARKET (04:00-09:20 ET) on gapping names, with Phase B's limit-order and exit mechanics, make money after the real SIP spread, more than random premarket minutes, and enough per day to pay for real-time SIP? This is T1 of docs/SIP_MONTH_PLAN_2026-10-15.md, simulated on free historical SIP before any SIP purchase.
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-29 ~04:20 ET in chat, after the premarket status review ('I wanna see where our project is in trading pre-market... In preparation for hitting that benchmark'), to the offer to simulate premarket entries on historical SIP before any SIP purchase: 'Yes, simulate first'.
registered_at: 2026-10-29 ~04:30 ET, before any code or data pull for this study.
prior: Low. 106 premarket mention bursts 8/24-9/26: burst -> premarket peak median +6.5% (98% up) but burst -> 09:30 open median -1.8% and -> close -8.4% (spike and fade like RTH); premarket power bar FAIL (-2.5 bp t -2.1); the empty square scores ~0 gross in RTH on 230k events (slope_now_hist 10/28). Premarket spreads are wide (SIP median ~0.23R vs IEX 0.75R). Expected lift 0 +- 10 bp per trade; the economic bar is likely the binding one.
sessions: Every weekday with free Alpaca SIP minute bars from 2026-06-01 to 2026-10-23 (about 100 sessions), split by count in date order into EARLY and LATE halves. 2026-10-26 onward is not used (the desk's live premarket lane overlaps it).

universe.scan: Alpaca SIP 30-minute bars 04:00-09:30 ET for every symbol in the all-symbol daily panel with prior close $5-150 (free historical; prior-close and 20-session ADV from the raw, unadjusted daily panel).
universe.qualify: Point-in-time: a name-day enters at the first 1-minute bar starting 04:30..09:15 ET whose close is >= 1.05 x prior close (a gapper), cumulative volume since 04:00 >= 50,000 shares, and cumulative dollar volume since 04:00 >= $2,000,000. Nothing at or after that bar's close is used for selection.
universe.price_band_primary: qualifying close $20-100 (the desk's live price band).
universe.seats: At most 6 names per day held in the book at once, admitted in qualification order (Phase B ai_phase_b_max_seats 6); a later qualifier waits for a free seat.

entry.lines: Fast %R 21 / EMA 7 and slow %R 112 / EMA 3 on SIP 1-minute bars (the desk's settings), computed over the previous session's 09:30-16:00 bars followed by today's 04:00.. bars; empty minutes inside premarket are filled flat at the previous close (pitch_open.grid, gap fill 15 min).
entry.signal: pitch_open.empty_square on completed minutes (both lines >= -35, gap <= 15, not both >= -20, fast rising), onset only, 15-minute refractory per name, decision minutes 04:30..09:20 ET, at most 2 open positions at once (Phase B ai_phase_b_max_open 2).
entry.fill: Limit buy at min(ask x 1.0015, ask + $0.05) using the SIP NBBO at the decision second (the first second of the next minute), alive 45 s (Phase B ttl); filled at the limit only if a SIP trade prints at or below the limit within those 45 s, else UNFILLED (counted, no trade). Ask = the last SIP quote at or before the decision second.

exit.primary: Phase B mechanics simplified to what minute data can show: a 5% hard stop (ai_phase_b_hard_stop_pct) checked on SIP 1-minute lows (filled at the stop price, or at the next minute's open if it gapped through), else exit at the SIP 1-minute close 10 minutes after the fill, but never after 09:25 (Phase B flatten start; then exit at the 09:24 close).
exit.information: Exit at 09:25 (hold to the flatten); exit at the SIP 09:30 open (what a hand-off to RTH would see).

costing: Net = exit / fill - 1, minus the full SIP quoted spread at the decision second (bp of mid), charged once (the desk's standard). No commission (Alpaca).

controls.d: the same name, a random filled-able minute 5-60 minutes later within 04:30..09:20 and before the flatten, same fill and exit rules (seeded sha256(symbol|day|entry|'T1-d')).
controls.x: another universe name-day the same session, same decision minute, same rules (seeded 'T1-x').
controls.lift: lift_d = net(signal) - net(d); lift_x = net(signal) - net(x); a signal without a usable control is dropped from that lift (counted).

statistic: Per session the mean over that session's filled signal trades; sessions equal-weighted; day-clustered (std_scorer.day_stat), one-sided bounds at 0.975, t at n-1 df.
pass: T1 PASSES only if ALL hold for the $20-100 primary band: (1) mean net > 0 with t >= 2.0 over all scored sessions and > 0 in BOTH halves; (2) lift_d > 0 and lift_x > 0 in BOTH halves, each with t >= 1.65 over all sessions; (3) economics: projected net $/day = mean filled trades per day x mean net bp x $384 (the desk's per-trade size, 20% of $1,922) >= $4.70 (the SIP-only keep-bar in docs/SIP_MONTH_PLAN_2026-10-15.md), reported also at $9.50 (SIP + Discord); (4) >= 150 filled trades and >= 40 sessions with a filled trade; (5) fill rate >= 50% of limit orders (a premarket entry that rarely fills is not a strategy).
power: Count first, before any return is read: filled trades, sessions with a fill, and MDE per half = 3.08 x sd_session(net) / sqrt(sessions) from a d-vs-x placebo (net(d) - net(x)); MDE > 15 bp per half or fewer than 150 filled trades = UNDERPOWERED (no means read).
fail: Any half's mean net <= 0 = FAIL (refuted) regardless of t. Otherwise short of PASS = FAIL (not shown). Either way: premarket stays off the SIP case; the SIP month (if bought) tests only the regular-session items (T2-T6).
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3, then T1 earns a live paper slot only during a paid SIP month (Phase B on SIP prints, real limit orders), decided by the operator once the regular-session benchmark is met. A simulated pass alone never switches anything on.
information_only: Fill rate, unfilled count, entry spread (median, p90) by half-hour bucket 04:30-09:20.
Exit variants: hold to 09:25, to the 09:30 open.
Hard-stop hit rate and gap-through count.
Trades per day distribution (how many premarket entries the lane would take).
no_retuning: No other gap threshold, price band, volume floor, window, hold, stop or limit pad is scored as primary.
data_budget: Free Alpaca historical only (SIP 30-minute scan bars, SIP 1-minute bars, SIP quotes and trades at each decision second). Runs after hours, after the Leg-1 replay queue, one heavy Alpaca job at a time; quote/trade pulls cached on disk outside /tmp.
script: tools/studies/premarket_t1_sim.py (scan, minute, signals, fills, score with count / canary / score modes, reusing pitch_open's lines/empty_square/fires and std_scorer) is written after a result-skeptic READY and may not change anything above.

amended.when: 2026-10-29 ~05:00 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (10 findings), before any code or data pull.
amended.1_costing: Replaces 'costing'. Entry price = the SIP ask at the decision second if the ask is at or below the limit and the order fills; otherwise the limit when filled by later prints. Exit = the SIP bid at the exit second (stop: the bid at the first quote after the trigger, or the next-minute open minus half the spread at that moment if it gapped). No separate spread charge. Entry and exit spreads are reported separately.
amended.2_fill: Replaces entry.fill. Primary limit = min(L x 1.0015, L + $0.05), L = the last SIP trade at or before the decision second, at most 15 s old (ai_phase_b_print_max_age_sec); no fresh print = NO ORDER (counted). Filled only if the SIP ask is at or below the limit at the decision second, or if SIP trades strictly below the limit (at-the-limit prints do not count: queue) add up to at least the order size floor($384 / limit) shares within 45 s. The ask-anchored version is information only.
amended.3_quotes: A quote is usable only if bid > 0, ask > bid and quote age <= 15 s; otherwise no order (counted).
amended.4_data_guards: Drop a name-day if the first premarket trade is more than 30% from the prior close and a corporate action is on record, or if the daily panel shows |close/prev - 1| > 30% on a split date (pitch_open SPLIT_JUMP). The daily panel must be named and cover through 2026-10-23 (the 2025-09-01..2026-10-02 panel does not; it is extended from raw Alpaca daily bars before any scan). Failed data batches are counted per day; a session with any failed batch fails closed (excluded, counted).
amended.5_scan: Replaces universe.scan's role: the scan keeps a name if any 30-min high >= 1.05 x prior close and 04:00-09:30 volume >= 50,000, a strict superset of the qualify rule; selection is re-applied on 1-min bars only. No ADV floor (the live ai_phase_b_min_prior_dollar_vol is 0); the 20-session ADV is not used.
amended.6_seats_controls: Seats = the first 6 qualifiers per day, never released. x is drawn from names in the $20-100 band that qualified at or before the decision minute. d is drawn uniformly from [entry - 60, entry + 60] minutes excluding |delta| < 5, at or after the name's qualification minute and at or before 09:20, with the same hold length as the signal (including any 09:24 truncation).
amended.7_exit_detail: Hold = from the fill second to the exit second 10 minutes later (capped at 09:24:59). The stop is checked on SIP trades after the fill, not on the fill minute's low before the fill. A missing minute uses the bid at that second.
amended.8_economics: Replaces pass (3). Per session $ = sum over its filled signal trades of net_i x $384, with $0 on sessions without a trade. The bar is mean $/day >= $4.70 over ALL sessions, in both halves (equivalently >= ~122 bp-trades/day); $9.50 reported.
amended.9_wording_robustness: The power gate runs first. If powered: any half's mean net <= 0 is FAIL (not supported); 'refuted' only if the all-session 97.5% upper bound is < 0. Add to pass: >= 20 sessions with fills in each half, and the pass survives dropping the top 3 days and the top 5 names (pitch_open drop_days / drop_names).
amended.10_live_path: This tests the empty-square (presquare) arm with a fixed hold; the live Phase B arm is full square OR presquare (exhaustion_allows_buy) with working-sell / flatten exits. A pass does not transfer to the live Phase B arm without a replay of that arm. Reported (information): the median wall-clock span of the fast %R window at signals (premarket gaps over 15 min are not filled).

amended_2.when: 2026-10-29 ~05:10 ET, result-skeptic round 2 (FIX FIRST, text only), fix text applied verbatim, before any code or data pull.
amended_2.A1_overrides_controls: Overrides: any amended key replaces conflicting original text (controls.d, costing, exit.primary, pass (3)). d and x orders use exactly the amended 2_fill, 3_quotes, 1_costing and 7_exit_detail rules: their own L and limit, the same 45 s strictly-below fill, entry at ask or limit, exit at bid, stop on trades. Candidates are minutes whose control order fills under that rule, drawn uniformly. Every candidate's full hold must end by 09:24:59. Controls never use a seat or an open slot. An unfilled signal has no lift, and a signal with no fillable candidate is dropped from that lift (counted).
amended_2.A2_exit_quotes: Exit uses the last usable quote (bid > 0, ask > bid) at or before the exit second, no older than 15 s. If none, use the first usable quote within the next 60 s. If there is still none, the exit is missing_exit (counted; the trade is dropped from the score, and its signal is dropped from both lifts). Stop exit = the bid of the first usable quote after the triggering trade. Delete 'next-minute open minus half the spread'. Immediate fill at the ask also needs ask size >= order shares; otherwise the order fills only by later prints.
amended_2.A3_data: A failed batch is retried with backoff until it succeeds or 3 attempts fail. Sessions excluded for data are listed with their scan-candidate counts. If more than 5% of sessions are excluded, the study is VOID, not scored. This applies to quote and trade pulls for signals and controls too. Split check: drop a name-day if the prior close from the Alpaca daily bar with adjustment='split' differs from the raw prior close by more than 1%, or if there is a split or reverse split in Alpaca corporate actions between the prior session and the day.
amended_2.A4_robustness: Survives = after dropping the top 3 days (by session mean net), and separately the top 5 names (by summed net), the all-session mean net > 0, lift_d > 0 and lift_x > 0.
amended_2.A5_panel: The panel extension adds rows only for symbols already in the panel. Symbols new after 2026-10-02 are added only if their listing date is at least 1 session before the day. The script reports how many panel symbols have no bars after their last date (survivorship check).
